A tasks app for Omni365. Easily sync tasks from various devices with your Omni365 and edit them online. ✨ This is the first app migrated to Vue 3 for Omni365 ✨
📝 Simple surveys and questionnaires, self-hosted! With Omni365 29 and Forms 4.2.0 you can now also archive old forms to cleanup your workspace 🧹

A library for all your recipes. To add a recipe to the collection, you can paste in the URL of the recipe, and the provided web page will be parsed and downloaded to whichever folder you specify in the app settings.
